Name: Dreamburrows Elliott Portrait
Author: DreamBurrow
Description:
[center]




[img]https://c2.staticflickr.com/2/1600/25696231710_c9567341dc_o.png[/img]

Hello There!~
Lately, I've become obsessed with Stardew Valley and became smitten with a certain character.
I adored Elliott's personality but wanted to give him a new appearance to match my own preferences.
So I drew new sprites for his portraits and tried my best to emulate the original art style of the game.
Decided to share it here.

[b]Installation::
- Download file
- Extract
- Open your Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits folder
- Back up your Elliott.xnb file that's in your Portraits folder, just in case.
- Copy my new Elliott.xnb file from this download over to your Portraits Folder.
- Boom! Load up your game and enjoy your new Elliott![/b]

Remember, these were made with my own preferences in mind. I understand this is not a look for everyone, and that's okay! 
Will be happy to take suggestions and what not!


Enjoy!~[/center]

Downloads.Description: A simple mod that replaces Elliott's original portrait.
